text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the February Stakes, where 
she vowed to take 1st, Smart Falcon also 
decides to enter the Kawasaki Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running back-to-back races will be tough, 
but she'll pull through with pure grit. 
Fired up with "gyururun" energy, she heads 
for the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Smart Falcon, the audience 
dreamed of seeing her shine in overseas 
races. Smart Falcon grew even more fired 
up.
